messages:
Nina: Heads-up — promo credits tied to Q3 Infrastructure grant didn't apply to EU invoices; billing shows a ~€18k overage on dedicated-eu-west-1. Anyone else seeing this? Invoice: INV-2026-0793
Raj: Saw same for acct bc-8492, credits show in 'global promo pool' instead of 'billing account eu-west'. Looks like partner applied credits to wrong billing account.
Olivia: Can you paste the billing account id and the credit id? I can query the GCP console.
Raj: ran a quick check:
```bash
gcloud beta billing credits list --billing-account=01A2B3-EUW
```
Result: CT-2026-09-EU appears under `000-main-global` with applied_amount: 0 and status: EXPIRED.
CostBot: AUTO — Credit CT-2026-09-EU marked EXPIRED (2026-02-28). Remaining balance: 0.
Nina: Hmm. The contract (DC-4578 reserved commit) clearly references CT-2026-09-EU as promo. We should have had it auto-applied to dedicated-eu-west usage. Is there a mapping bug between partner billing account and our reserved commit?
Olivia: Could be a mismatch in billing account mapping for partner-managed credits. @Sam finance-svc can you confirm whether partner pushed credits to the global account by mistake?
Sam: Opening support case with partner now. I'll include invoice INV-2026-0793, commit DC-4578, and the promo T&C. Case: PROD-BILL-412.
Raj: Also, running a quick audit across regions to ensure other commits weren't affected. If it's systemic, we need retro-apply and credit the overages to the monthly reserved commit ledger.
Nina: Note: promo T&C had a clause for retroactive application if commitment met before expiry — might be leverage to recover charges.
Sam: Confirmed — partner rep requested the contract doc. I'll push it and ask for retro-apply. ETA 48h.
Raj: I'll prepare a script to reconcile invoice line items by billing-account id and commit-id. Quick snippet to grab lines:
```bash
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28 --granularity MONTHLY --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"BILLING_ACCOUNT","Values":["01A2B3-EUW"]}}'
```
Olivia: Thanks — tag me on the ticket once it's created. Also enabling alert for credits landing on non-matching billing accounts.
Nina: Good call. Please add a postmortem note if partner retro-applies any credits so we can update internal chargeback and forecast.
Sam: Will do. PROD-BILL-412 created and partners cc'd. Uploading docs now.
Nina: Thanks all :thumbsup:
